items.title: Telangana police constable suspended for abusive remarks against TRS chief Kavitha
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. A Telangana police constable, K Anil, was suspended for allegedly posting misogynistic, sexually abusive remarks on social media against Telangana Rakshana Sena (TRS) president and former MP Kalvakuntla Kavitha. Cyberabad Commissioner of Police M Ramesh issued the suspension order against Anil, an Armed Reserve (AR) police constable, on September 2. Earlier the same day, a complaint was submitted to Telangana Director General of Police (DGP), seeking criminal and departmental action against Anil for his comments on Kavitha on a social media post. The complaint, submitted by TRS members, alleged that the constable circulated the objectionable remarks on Facebook, X and other social media platforms. Seeking registration of an FIR, the complainant invoked provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including those relating to insulting the modesty of a woman, sexual harassment and criminal defamation, besides applicable provisions of the Information Technology (IT) Act.
